title: Integrated Studies — Final Assessment
subject: Integrated Studies
description: Grade 2 end-of-year Integrated Studies final: the body, healthy living, safety, and family.

sections.name: The Body
sections.instruction: Choose the best answer about the parts of your body.

questions.prompt: Which body part helps you think and controls your whole body?
questions.hint: It is inside your head and is like the boss of your body.

questions.prompt: What is the main job of the heart?
options: To pump blood around the body
questions.correct: To pump blood around the body
questions.hint: You can feel it beating in your chest.

questions.prompt: The hard frame of bones inside your body that gives you shape and protects you is called the ______.
questions.hint: It is made of many bones joined together.

questions.prompt: What do muscles and joints help you do?
questions.hint: Think about your knees and elbows when you run and bend.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a job of the skeleton?
options: It protects the soft parts inside the body
questions.correct: It protects the soft parts inside the body
questions.hint: The ribs are bones that keep the heart and lungs safe.

sections.name: Keeping the Body Healthy
sections.instruction: Answer these questions about food, exercise, and staying healthy.

questions.prompt: Go foods give us energy to run and play. Which one is a Go food?
questions.hint: Go foods are things like bread, rice, and yam.

questions.prompt: Grow foods help build the body and make it strong. Which one is a Grow food?
questions.hint: Grow foods are things like meat, fish, eggs, and peas.

questions.prompt: Glow foods protect the body and keep us well. Which one is a Glow food?
questions.hint: Glow foods are fruits and vegetables.

questions.prompt: We should drink plenty of this every day to keep our body healthy. What is it?
questions.hint: It is clear, it has no colour, and it comes from the tap.

questions.prompt: Which of these helps keep your body healthy?
questions.hint: A healthy body needs rest and moving around.

sections.name: Staying Safe
sections.instruction: Choose the safe thing to do at home, at school, and on the road.

questions.prompt: Which of these is NOT safe to play with at home?
questions.hint: Fire can burn you, so it is only for grown-ups.

questions.prompt: What should you do to stay safe in the school hallway?
options: Run as fast as you can
questions.hint: Running inside can make you slip and fall.

questions.prompt: Before you cross the road, what should you do?
options: Look both ways and cross at the crossing
questions.correct: Look both ways and cross at the crossing
questions.hint: Look left and right so you can see all the cars.

questions.prompt: What does a RED traffic light tell cars to do?
questions.hint: Red means stop, green means go.

sections.name: Our Family
sections.instruction: Answer these questions about families and the family tree.

questions.prompt: On a family tree, what do we call your mother's mother and father?
questions.hint: They are your parents' mother and father.
